tasks.final_text: I do not like open-ended questions and prompts like this. However, I am a master hacker and know that the next section of this quiz will be to transcribe a piece of text. I will be able to transcribe that easier than I can write this because all I need to do is read the text and type it.

The National Museum of Galle (Galle National Museum) is one of the national museums of Sri Lanka. It is located in teh oldest remaining Dutch building in the Galle fort, Galle, a single storey colonnaded Dutch building built in 1656 as the commissariat store for the Dutch garrison at the fort.
